subject: Mythology
title: The Dwarves: Master Craftsmen
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Dwarves: Master Craftsmen.

hook.text: Norse dwarves lived underground and forged the most powerful magical objects in all the nine worlds.

buildup.text: They made Thor's hammer, Odin's spear Gungnir, and Freya's golden necklace Brisingamen.

discovery.text: When Loki bet his own head that dwarves could not outdo their finest work, they forged Mjolnir to prove him wrong.

twist.text: The dwarves won the bet. Loki argued they could have his head but not his neck, escaping on a technicality.

climax.text: Furious, the dwarves sewed Loki's lips shut with wire, silencing the trickster god for a time.

punchline.text: The only ones who ever outsmarted Loki lived underground.

quiz.question: What did the dwarves do when Loki escaped their bet on a technicality?
options: They cursed him to lose his shapeshifting powers
They sewed his lips shut with wire
They reported him to Odin for judgment
